answer: One umber quarry face on shale ground for 120 days: 150 token deposit, 95 dollar license, one face per applicant. The office seals a sample from the first dig in a numbered vault case. Weekly the applicant logs kilos dug, sold, and left, while a neighbor signs the tally and a surveyor checks the face twice. A forged tally forfeits the deposit and bars the applicant 180 days. Faking 10,000 quarries freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 950,000 dollars. Like a baker who must show an empty flour sack before the bread counts, a pit whose walls never recede loses its license.
